frozen: 2026-11-05, committed after PR-A (#187) and PR-B (#185) were merged and before the registered live run; never edited after seeing its results
scope: Matrix UX08 (HP, HNP), UX09 (HP, HNP) and UX10 (HNP) of P0. Live cells against the live stack: real Merchant, real payment provider and ephemeral PostgreSQL of tests/integration, with the real OpenAI SDK over a scripted transport. CI cells: the pytest node ids of ci_cells, run once at the same Agent commit, without network. No real model, no provider call, no cost.

harness.model_double: tests/support/model_server.py: httpx.MockTransport given to the SDK's HTTP clients in the test process; ScriptedModel (tests/integration/live_model.py) serves the case's script from this module's answers
harness.held_answer: held(...) of tests/support/model_server.py: `entered` is set when its request arrives and the response waits for `release`. The test stops the run while it waits (HP: the client closes its connection; HNP: the owner revokes or the operator turns the kill switch on) and then releases it
harness.hp_agent: HpAgent of tests/integration/test_p0_model_failures.py: AgentServer (uvicorn on 127.0.0.1) in the test process, create_app with ExplicitSettings, buyer authenticated by EpisodeBuyer. The chat is POST /assistant over a real connection; REST is POST /conversation/turn; approval, cancel and completion are the Agent's own HTTP routes (POST /purchases/{run_id}/approval, /cancel, /complete), as the UI calls them
harness.hp_disconnect: the client streams POST /assistant on its own connection and closes it while the answer is held; a test hook on RunController._mark_cancelled sets an event when the server marks the run cancelled, and the release waits for it plus release_after_mark_ms; a hook on AssistantTransport._turn_worker sets an event when the worker ends
harness.hp_cancel_route: the b0 lane's proxy does not allowlist POST /checkout_sessions/*/cancel (its tests never cancel through the Agent); UX08-HP and UX08-HP-control add that route for the case and restore the allowlist after it
harness.approval_note: the B2-HP approval goes through the Agent's HTTP route, not through Agent.approve of tests/integration/live_purchase.py:451, which always takes the current fingerprint and cannot express «approve B with fA»
harness.hnp_agent: ModelHnpAgent (tests/integration/live_model.py): the variables of HnpAgent for B2-HNP, served in the test process with AGENT_HNP_SELECTOR=llm and, where stated, AGENT_HNP_REVIEWER=llm
harness.hnp_stop: revoke: HnpAgent.revoke (the buyer's POST /delegations/{grant_id}/revoke on its own connection); kill: HnpAgent.as_operator('POST', '/internal/hnp/kill-switch', {enabled: true}); revoke_after_checkout_post: HnpAgent.revoke inside the Merchant proxy's after_answer hook of POST /checkout_sessions. The stop mark is the length of the Merchant and PSP proxy logs right before the stop is sent
harness.credential: synthetic; only the scripted transport sees it

execution_order_reason: Cells that must leave no effect run first, then the cells whose checkouts are declared (no order), then the controls that prepare a checkout or buy, so no effect of a later cell can fall inside the window of an earlier one. The three repetitions of a cell run one after the other.

not_applicable.UX09-HP-REST: REST is synchronous, the runners use it and it has no way to be interrupted: a second request waits for the lock and gets the pending-purchase guard (spec §2.2, §4.4). Declared, not executed, not counted.
not_applicable.UX10-HP: the matrix puts UX10 only in HNP (spec §4.4).
not_applicable.UX10-HNP-c (live): the live Merchant has no fault that answers quantity 2 (spec §4.4); UX10-HNP-c runs in CI only.
not_applicable.UX10-HNP-a and UX08-HNP (live): no model and nothing the stack adds (spec §5.2); CI only.

conditions.B2-HP: b0 lane; AGENT_GOVERNANCE_MODE=enforce, AGENT_HP_FLOW=governed, policy set b2-hp-v2, AP2 on (settings_for of tests/integration/test_live_b2_d2_authorization.py), plus the synthetic model settings. A new Merchant episode and a new Agent SQLite per repetition.
conditions.B2-HNP: hnp lane; the variables of HnpAgent for B2-HNP (hnp_condition of tests/integration/live_purchase.py), AGENT_HNP_SELECTOR=llm, AGENT_HNP_REVIEWER=off unless the case says reviewer, plus the synthetic model settings. A new Merchant episode and a new Agent SQLite per repetition. The buyer delegates with delegation_request of tests/integration/live_purchase.py (city Bogotá), total_max = the variant's observed price + 500,000.00 COP, then the service token triggers the task.

requests.request_b: «Mejor quiero el OnePlus 8T de 256 GB.» (the chat's «Mejor quiero B»)
requests.hnp_variant: Q100286751-256GB unless the case says otherwise

stimuli.route_a: 200, structured CommerceDecision: action purchase, purchase_request PHONE_REQUEST, intent PHONE_INTENT
stimuli.choose_a: 200, structured choice of Q100286751-256GB (asserted in the request's JSON schema)
stimuli.route_b: 200, structured CommerceDecision: action purchase, purchase_request request_b, intent PHONE_INTENT with preference oneplus
stimuli.choose_b: 200, structured choice of Q100348826-256GB (asserted in the request's JSON schema)
stimuli.route_respond: 200, structured CommerceDecision: action respond, «Entendido. Dime qué quieres buscar.»
stimuli.choice_ok: 200, structured choice of the first id the request's JSON schema admits (shortlisted_choice)

script_semantics: Each HTTP attempt takes the next answer of the case's script; the last answer persists for any later attempt, so an attempt beyond the oracle receives the same stimulus and is counted instead of breaking the double.

measures.model_http_attempts: requests the scripted transport received in the window the oracle names
measures.checkout_posts: POST /checkout_sessions through the lane's Merchant proxy
measures.merchant_checkouts: the episode's checkout_sessions rows read by the Merchant control (checkout_id, status, offer_id, quantity), never through the Agent
measures.events_after_claim: the grant's delegation_events from task_claimed on, choice_reviewed left out
measures.after_stop: Merchant POSTs and PSP requests in the proxy logs after the stop mark
measures.model_requests: the Agent's model_requests rows of the window, projected to (stage, outcome, error_kind, http_status, provider_error_code, retries); recorded, and an oracle only where the case says so

zero_effects.window: HP: from right before the stopped turn to after the next turn (or the stopped turn, when there is none). HNP: from right before the trigger to the terminal task.
outside_agent: no POST /checkout_sessions through the lane's Merchant proxy
the checkouts of the episode run unchanged (none before, none after)
the full Merchant snapshot (count and SHA-256 of every table) equal before and after
PSP: no request through the payment proxy (HNP), the delegations (vt_ tokens) count unchanged and the full PSP SQLite snapshot equal before and after
agent_ledger: no new row in approvals, completion_results, grant_reservations, dispatch_outbox, orders, hp_evidence, governance_evidence, ap2_evidence and no closed mandate
purchases exactly as the case's oracle

limits.left_to_d1_reconciliation: task_finished records checkout_cancel {checkout_id, result: left_to_d1_reconciliation} for any checkout_failed whose purchase D1 left uncertain, not only for a quantity mismatch (for example a timeout of the details update in B2-HNP). It cancels nothing, but it changes the body of task_finished in those new B2-HNP runs.
limits.ux10_hnp_c_b2: in B2-HNP the two-unit checkout stays open at the Merchant until D1's reconciliation resolves the uncertain purchase
limits.ux09_hnp_rev: the purchase the reviewer opened ends canceled without a checkout
limits.d4_scope: D4 does not cover grant_expired, policy_denied, governance_unavailable, mandate_proof_invalid, checkout_failed at the close, the claim after a crash, nor a D1 uncertain state
limits.d1_deviation: UX08's «Actualizar propuesta» is two steps (cancel A, then ask for B), as decision D1 of the spec states

development_runs: Before freezing, three development runs (not evidence, not registered) exercised the harness on the same stack. The first two ran the first repetition only. The first stopped at UX09-HP-a: a discarded line iterator closed the chat's connection before the model was called, so the stimulus never happened (stimulus_verified false); the harness keeps the iterator now. The second passed 15/15. The third, at df3df33 with only the §3.2 fix reverted, ran the three UX09-HP stop cases three times: UX09-HP-race failed 3/3 (the checkout was created), UX09-HP-a and UX09-HP-b passed 3/3, so live only UX09-HP-race discriminates §3.2. No oracle changed after them.

UX09-HP-a.stimulus: chat «Quiero A» with route_a held; the client closes the connection; route_a is released 100 ms after the server marked the run cancelled; then a new turn «hola»

UX09-HP-b.stimulus: chat «Quiero A» with route_a answered and choose_a held (the catalog already read); the client closes the connection; choose_a is released 100 ms after the server marked the run cancelled; then a new turn «hola»

UX09-HP-race.stimulus: chat «Quiero A» with route_a answered and choose_a held; the client closes the connection; choose_a is released as soon as the server marked the run cancelled (0 ms), observed with a test hook on RunController._mark_cancelled
UX09-HP-race.note: Evidence over the real server. The deterministic oracle of spec §3.2 is the CI unit test (ci_cells UX09-HP-race). The window between the TCP close and is_cancelled is declared in §3.2 and not measured: the release waits for the mark.

UX09-HNP-sel-kill.stimulus: choice_ok held; while it is held the operator turns the kill switch on (POST /internal/hnp/kill-switch {enabled: true}); then it is released

UX08-HP.stimulus: chat turn 1 «Quiero A» (route_a, choose_a): A awaiting approval with fingerprint fA. Turn 2 «Mejor quiero B» on the chat and on REST, with route_b queued. Cancel A (POST /purchases/{run_a}/cancel). Turn 3 «Mejor quiero B» (route_b, choose_b): B with fB. Then approve B with fA and B's checkout_jwt; approve A with fA; complete B without approval

oracle.no_payment_effects: no /complete, no new PSP token, PSP snapshot equal, no Merchant order
oracle.agent_ledger: no approvals, completion_results, orders, ap2_evidence nor D2 governance_evidence row
